—The idea of tracking a project is to determine the STATUS of the project as is the practice on catalyst website. The objective is to know whether a project is complete or in progress. —On measuring the Impact: There is a feature at the top of page of the site with the title *Impact report*. A tap on the download feature gives you access to the impact report there.
